methodology: Single-use held-out bank, v5. Written blind: the author did not open the product article corpus, writers, evidence, explainers, team notes or any prior bank's questions. Gold phrases are well-established public XRPL / x402 / regulatory facts. v5 supersedes v4 as the single-use held-out set; v4 is now used and historical. Frozen at commit; no post-run question or gold edits.
